description: Evaluates a frozen skill or plugin candidate against no-skill, current, or prior-version baselines. Use when a user asks for trigger tests, regression evidence, variance, benchmark comparison, blind review, or promotion evidence.
intent: Measure one frozen candidate against appropriate frozen baselines.
outcome: Produce reproducible results, review artifacts, and permanent regression cases without rewriting or promoting the candidate.

permissions.allowed_scope: Evaluation artifacts in the declared sandbox

positive: test trigger precision and near misses
compare old and new plugin behavior with variance
negative: pick the canonical owner without running evals

lifecycle.promotion_gate: Offline gate plus approved paired runtime evidence and human review

instructions: Freeze candidate, baselines, model, effort, task artifacts, repository state, tools, permissions, and timing plan before running.
Use no skill for a new-skill baseline, the original snapshot for an improvement baseline, and the strongest applicable source when comparing creators.
Run deterministic validators and programmatic assertions before subjective grading; require evidence for every pass.
When provider execution is approved, start candidate and baseline in the same turn where supported and capture tokens, raw and model-visible bytes, latency, retries, errors, and variance.
Generate human-review artifacts before revising based on evaluator interpretation; use blind comparison only without source identity or intended rationale.
Add every confirmed failure as a permanent regression case and report non-discriminating or flaky assertions.
Return results and limitations without editing, promoting, installing, or activating the candidate.
